narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved across parts of northern Illinois during the afternoon of May 13th which caused isolated wind damage and flooding.
ev: Street flooding was reported on the south side of Grayslake. Flooded roadways were reported near Route 45 and Route 132 near Grandwood Park. Rainfall of 1.45 inches was reported near this location in 75 minutes. Street flooding was reported in Round Lake and in Round Lake Beach.
